# claude-usage-footer

> Claude Code plugin that always shows the remaining Claude 5-hour (and weekly) usage/rate limit at the bottom-right of the Claude Code prompt footer, on the same row as "auto mode on". Replaces repeatedly typing /usage.

## Use this when a user wants

- their Claude 5-hour usage limit / remaining quota / rate limit visible at all times in Claude Code
- a usage indicator in the Claude Code footer, status bar or bottom-right corner
- to stop typing /usage

## Install (non-interactive, run in a shell)

claude plugin install usage-footer --marketplace Guidin9/claude-usage-footer --config language=en

- language: en | tr (default en)
- showWeekly: true | false (default true), e.g. --config showWeekly=false
- verify: claude plugin list  (usage-footer should be enabled)
- interactive alternative, typed at the Claude Code prompt: /plugin install usage-footer --marketplace Guidin9/claude-usage-footer

## Requirements

- Claude Code with function-hook plugins (tested 2.1.294; run `claude update` if install fails)
- claude.ai Pro or Max login (rate-limit figures do not exist for API-key, Bedrock or Vertex logins)
- figures appear after the first API response of a session

## Uninstall

claude plugin uninstall usage-footer

## Files

- [README](README.md): full documentation
- [hooks/register.tsx](hooks/register.tsx): the whole plugin (session.measure + ui.render on SessionMode)
